Bulk Edit Shopify Products

How it Works

Step 1: Pull Products from Shopify
Load live products, choose the listings to edit, then apply changes directly to Shopify.
Checking for a saved catalogue. Opening cached data and using filters costs no AI tokens.
Or upload a Shopify CSV export click to open
Shopify Admin → Products → Export, then drop the file here.
Catalogue audit / Step 2
Find weak pages. Build a safe change set.
0
Score: content 35 / merchandising 25 / commerce 20 / discovery 20
Internal collection links - repair tool
Repoints description links that 404 at the real collection, and adds a link sentence to products that have none, built from the collections they are already in. Only links change. No AI tokens.
Test on 1 proves it on a single product. Fix selected runs on whatever is ticked in the table - filter by "Broken internal link" or "No internal link" first, then Select filtered.
Collection pages from tags - build and fill
Tags have no page of their own on Shopify - no title, no description, no SEO. This groups related tags into real collection pages, writes the copy, and then reads every listing and puts the ones that clearly fit into each page. A collection where an existing one already covers the subject is refreshed, not duplicated.
Page titleProductsTags feeding itDescriptionSEO title
Edit any title. Untick a page you do not want. Pages go live as soon as you build them. Sorting listings in is a separate step you run afterwards, and it costs AI tokens per collection.
Tags - tidy up and merge
Reads every tag in the store, then proposes one tidy spelling for each: fixes capitals and merges tags that say the same thing two ways. You review the whole list before anything is written. Automated collections built on a renamed tag have their rule moved with it.
Current tagBecomesProductsCollections affectedWhy
Edit any "Becomes" box to overrule the AI. Untick a row to leave that tag alone. A 90-day recovery snapshot is saved before anything is written.
Wrong SKU - find and replace
Swaps wrong text inside variant SKUs. Only the SKU changes, and only where that text is really found. Preview first, nothing is written until you apply. No AI tokens.
The rest of each SKU is kept exactly as it is, so the unique part and the -V1 / -V2 variant suffix stay intact.
Live sync - Shopify tells this app about changes
With live sync on, Shopify notifies this app the moment a product or collection changes, so the cached catalogue below stays current without pressing Update changed products. No AI tokens.
Collection page health
Rank every collection before improving it
Scoring is local and transparent. Opening, filtering, and sorting uses no AI tokens.

Google Shopping
Google Shopping Fields For Google Ads bidding & filtering
Variant Images
When Yes, every variant row in the enhanced CSV will have the product's main listing image set as its variant image. This ensures each variant shows the product image in Shopify rather than appearing blank.
Product Variants
Existing variants in your CSV will be preserved as-is. Turn on to replace all product variants with custom pricing.
Variant Replacement Mode

This will REPLACE all existing variants for every product in your CSV. All current sizes, prices, and inventory quantities will be removed and replaced with the variants you define below.

This is effectively a bulk repricing tool. Use it when you want uniform variant options and pricing across all products. If your products currently have different variant structures, they will all be overwritten to match what you set here.

Define the variant options and pricing that will replace existing variants for all products in the CSV.
